step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows two main data ingests into Redshift and S3 Data Lake. In the bottom flow, on-premises data (ONPREM) connects through an AWS VPN to DMS, which migrates/loads data directly into Amazon Redshift. In the top flow, order files land in an S3 drop bucket, which sends notification messages to SQS. SQS triggers an initiator Lambda function that queries/retrieves metadata from DynamoDB and writes raw/refined files into an S3 Data Lake bucket. S3 events on the Data Lake then trigger a second Lambda function that processes/merges data and loads it into Redshift. There is also a direct data link from the Data Lake to Redshift.
